query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.travel_time_cache (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  organization_id uuid NOT NULL,
  origin text DEFAULT 'base',
  destination text NOT NULL,
  destination_normalized text NOT NULL,
  departure_hour_bucket integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  travel_minutes_one_way real,
  travel_minutes_with_traffic real,
  distance_meters real,
  google_maps_status text,
  source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'google',
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE(organization_id, destination_normalized, departure_hour_bucket)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_travel_time_cache_org_dest 
  ON public.travel_time_cache(organization_id, destination_normalized);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_travel_time_cache_expires 
  ON public.travel_time_cache(expires_at);

ALTER TABLE public.travel_time_cache ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
